title: Fix: 3 impacted-suite tests broken by default-on verify cache
action: REPRO FIRST (already red): node scripts/tests/test_run_verify_impacted.mjs -> 34 passed, 3 failed — the 3 assertions expecting a suite's own PASS line now get 'CACHED green ... (closure unchanged)' because tbf-1's cache is default-on locally and .bee/logs/verify-cache.json is warm. Test intent is selection logic + real execution, so KEEP the assertions and make the three run_verify child invocations in scripts/tests/test_run_verify_impacted.mjs pass --no-cache (or set env CI=1) so cached shortcuts never apply inside this suite: the failing three are the --impacted self-select case, the --level 1 case, and the --only case. Do NOT weaken any assertion; do NOT touch run_verify.mjs. End green: 37 passed, 0 failed.

truths: All three previously-failing assertions unchanged in what they assert.
prohibitions: Do NOT delete or weaken assertions.
Do NOT clear the live cache file as the fix (tests must be hermetic against a warm cache).
